name: Titanium.UI.iOS.AnchorAttachmentBehavior
summary: Dynamic behavior to support connections between an anchor point and an item.
description:
An anchor attachment behavior creates a dynamic connection between an anchor point and an item.
To define an anchor attachment behavior:

  1. Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.createAnchorAttachmentBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#createAnchorAttachmentBehavior) method to create a behavior.
  2. Set the [anchor](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.AnchorAttachmentBehavior#anchor) and
     [item](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.AnchorAttachmentBehavior#item) properties.
  3. Add the behavior to the [Animator object](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Animator).

To create a dynamic connection between two items, use [Titanium.UI.iOS.ViewAttachmentBehavior](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.ViewAttachmentBehavior).

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: anchor
properties.summary: Anchor point for the attachment behavior relative to the animator's coordinate system.

properties.name: damping
properties.summary: Amount of damping to apply to the attachment behavior.

properties.name: distance
properties.summary: Distance, in points, between the two attachment points.

properties.name: frequency
properties.summary: Frequency of oscillation for the behavior.

properties.name: item
properties.summary: Item to connect to use the attachment behavior.

properties.name: offset
properties.summary: Offset from the center point of the item for the attachment.
